policies.title: Indian ordinary passports: Peru advance tourist visa
policies.summary: Peru's current ordinary-passport table marks India visa-required by default and waives that requirement only for holders of specified third-country visas or permanent residence. The current Embassy procedure requires advance application and in-person processing in New Delhi.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Indian passport holder visiting as a tourist without the table's qualifying United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia or Schengen visa or permanent-residence exception.

Apply before travel through the Embassy of Peru in New Delhi. The current procedure requires consular submission and an in-person interview and says processing normally takes 7 to 10 working days after the interview.

The source states a multiple-entry tourist visa validity of up to 183 days. Work, residence, transit, special documents, qualifying-document exceptions and final admission remain outside this baseline.

application.label: Peruvian Embassy in India tourist-visa procedure
steps: Prepare the ordinary passport and the documents required by the official Embassy procedure.
Submit and process the application through the Embassy of Peru in New Delhi before travel.
Attend the required in-person interview and wait for the consular decision before travelling.
